description.value: Mello is an artisan donut shop in Vancouver's Chinatown specializing in fresh brioche donuts made entirely from scratch each day, with fillings ranging from Madagascar vanilla custard and tiramisu to an Everything Bagel cream cheese option. The shop rotates seasonal and specialty flavours regularly and also serves coffee using a custom blend from Agro Roasters. Donuts can be pre-ordered online or purchased in-store while supplies last — the handmade process means sell-outs are common.

address.value: 223 E Pender St, Vancouver, BC V6A 2T9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this OSM record corresponds to the active Mello Chinatown location at 223 E Pender St — address and phone match exactly. The site explicitly states 'We currently do not have VEGAN/GF donuts,' and confirms in-store pickup and pre-order as the primary service model. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or device charging anywhere on the site; the Arbutus location is noted as closed since February 17, 2025 but does not affect this record.
concerns: A third Mello location (Arbutus) closed February 17, 2025; this OSM record correctly points to the Chinatown location which is confirmed open and unaffected.
OSM address omits postal code; website gives full address 223 E Pender St Vancouver BC V6A 2T9 — used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating artisan donut and coffee shop in Vancouver's Chinatown with a confirmed address, phone, and open status. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a quick sweet treat and coffee.
enrichment_extras.notes: Mello also operates a second location at Time Out Market, 650 W 41st Ave (Oakridge Park) — that location may warrant a separate OSM record check.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ explicitly states: 'We currently do not have VEGAN/GF donuts but we are working on it.' No vegetarian designation is made; nut cross-contamination also flagged for allergy-sensitive customers
